column1: # Linneo's protection policy for the data categories. Copyright 2026 the original author or authors.
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. fideslang assigns no protection level to its
# categories; these are Linneo's defaults. Every root declares all four facets; a key not listed
# inherits from its parent, and a listed value may only raise what the parent gives (see Taxonomy).
# Legal basis: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) as corrected (OJ L 127, 23.5.2018; EUR-Lex has no later
# consolidated text) and Ley Orgánica 3/2018 (LOPDGDD), consolidated text of 27 December 2025
# (BOE-A-2018-16673). Maximum protection, HIGH confidentiality and integrity (the builder enforces it
# for SPECIAL_CATEGORY and CRIMINAL_OFFENCE): special categories (GDPR and LOPDGDD art. 9) and criminal
# data (GDPR and LOPDGDD art. 10). HIGH confidentiality and integrity without that nature: administrative
# infringements and sanctions (LOPDGDD art. 27) and victim status (gender-based violence, sexual
# violence, terrorism). HIGH confidentiality: data of vulnerable data subjects (children: GDPR recital 38
# and art. 8, LOPDGDD art. 7; immigration and asylum status: EDPB WP248 rev.01), what grants access, and
# Columns: key, nature, confidentiality, integrity, secret (empty = inherit)
